sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 483 x 175 x 45 mm (w x d x h) (axis order assumed); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sonifex DHY-04 handbook rev 1.06 (dealer-hosted copy of the manufacturer document), opened 2026-11-12, rows for the DHY-04S: physical specification 4.5 cm H x 48.3 cm W x 17.5 cm D, 1U, 1.45 kg net (the plan size is the same; its axis assumption is settled by the handbook header order Height, Width, Depth). Rear panel: input XLR (mic/line and AES/EBU, auto-sensing), output XLR, telephone line and handset RJ11 (no catalogue connector, not modelled), conference RJ45 (analog audio, not Ethernet: not modelled), 9-way D remotes (no signal), Ethernet RJ45 (configuration), RS232, earth bond screw, filtered IEC mains (CEE22; iec-c14 assumed, plan assumedConnectors power-in). The handbook lists no power switch: the `power` control is the simulator toggle drawn as a rocker next to the inlet because the template requires one per mains inlet. The XLR input is modelled as the line-level send to the caller (it also accepts mic level and AES3). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
